behavior: All independent behavior checks, unchanged original tests, and final ordinary project suite pass.
testDelivery: Assert object array-like batching preserves holes separately from explicit undefined.
Assert length/getter read counts and string UTF16 behavior.
docDelivery: Explain accepted forms, bounds and validation order.
Explain shallow chunks, holes/inherited properties, UTF16 strings and getter failures.
coverage: Preserve old assertions or equivalent exercised behavior; inspect delivered tests by actual meaningful assertions, never exact names or matching reference source.
complete: Required behavior (including every explicit manualBehavior item, when present), preservation, ordinary suite, all listed tests and documentation must be delivered. Native status is separate.
domain: Bounded array-like stable length/index properties with ordinary inherited lookup; UTF16 strings, sparse/frozen arrays; no mutation during getters.
independence: Accept bounded array-like collections in a batching consumer while retaining holes and index order semantics.
